verdict.rationale: Remote documents a single `POST /v1/employments` endpoint for creating every employment type, with type-specific onboarding flows and per-country dynamic JSON schemas that define required fields. It also offers bidirectional sync for pushing people, contracts and payroll inputs, and a sandbox token, so an agent can drive employee creation through the API. Compensation and tax setup are not explicitly documented as API steps; they are only implied by the per-country schemas and 'payroll inputs'. The MCP write tools are limited to employee self-service, so they add no onboarding coverage. Missing for 10: explicit compensation and tax-setup endpoints or schema documentation, a documented end-to-end onboarding sequence through to completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven onboarding.
